stores.titleFormat: 'Name (Rarity) [SET - CODE]'. Rarity tags such as (C+), (R+), (LR+) and (SP) mark the parallel/foil printing. The bracket gives the set it was printed in, followed by the card number, e.g. a GD03 reprint inside GD04. Sealed products are on the main bardsandcards.com site. About 486 products.
